This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on August 26 across American network, syndicated, and armed forces radio, Anne Nichols' classic Abie's Irish Rose for Drene Shampoo, Tennessee Ernie Ford on The Ford Road Show, Joe E. Brown and Mel Blanc entertaining troops on AFRS G.I.
